integrity: Proof in RESULT.md is self-contained for the mixture, coupling, sharp stochastic extremality, and recovery identities; cites existing elementary component CDF rather than claiming it as new.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean triangles; independent uniform total-boundary arclength points; normalized area; similarity only. Conditional one-point-per-side area law was already published by Maesumi (2018) and is not claimed original. Inaccessible/unindexed historic literature may contain analogous unconditional laws. Monte Carlo is supplementary, not proof.
title: Sharp area-law ordering and shape reconstruction for triangles sampled by boundary arclength
